hero.title: Black Label
hero.subtitle: American street food elevated to the highest level. Burgers and charcoal-grilled meats, premium ingredients, and a rebellious atmosphere that redefines the gastronomic experience.

sections.title: Estrategia
sections.description: Black Label fuses the spirit of American street food with premium ingredients and a rebellious, urban aesthetic. Its concept pays homage to New York-Texan culture, both in its gastronomy and in the venue's design, capturing the essence of classic diners, Texan grills, and the vibrant style of big cities. Before our intervention, the brand needed to strengthen its identity and digital presence to convey its differential and connect better with its audience. To achieve this, we developed a striking branding and visual content strategy, focused on gastronomic storytelling and communication aligned with food marketing trends.

sections.title: Diseño
sections.description: We built its visual identity from scratch, defining a vintage-industrial aesthetic with a disruptive, street-level air, inspired by American urban culture. We worked with a dark palette of black, red, and gold, bold serif typography, and textures inspired by the world of motors, music, and rock & roll, with references to the Throwback Aesthetic and American sports. The Texan influence is reflected in the grill and charcoal, while the New York aesthetic comes alive in neon lights and urban details. The art direction bet on photography with intense close-ups, contrasted lighting, and metallic and wood backgrounds, reinforcing its powerful image. On social media, dynamic transitions and visual trends were applied to highlight the Black Label experience.

sections.title: Resultado
sections.description: The brand evolved toward a more premium and differentiated identity, establishing itself as a reference in gourmet burgers with an authentic and evocative character. Total visual coherence was achieved across social media, packaging, interior design, and customer experience, strengthening its positioning. Instagram engagement grew significantly, reservations increased, and Black Label consolidated itself as a reference gastronomic destination, transporting its customers to the most iconic essence of New York-Texan street food.
